goal: Prompt length review: prompts that repeat rules, examples or boilerplate across calls.
use: Prompt length review: prompts that repeat rules, examples or boilerplate across calls. Use when a prompt template is written or changed.

steps.note: Read the template. List each section and what it says.
Find repetition. Flag rules repeated in several places and examples that teach nothing new.
Check the examples. Keep the fewest that show the format.
Check the variables. Flag fields filled with more text than the call needs.
Report. Each section with its length, the repetition and the shorter wording.
